command: pre-registration: F6O2, F6 on new displaced states + arm M memory overlay (docs/SCAFFOLD_RESULTS.md 45.6)

metrics.caveat: The occluder leaks: in f6o the plate had pixels at 36-56% of later b/c queries (the policy disturbs the plate or the wrist reaches the cover). Kept as is. The cover's top lies about 8 cm above the plate plane measured from depth. M's occlusion rule changed twice before any rollout, both times after a policy-free check: height gate 3 cm -> 12 cm (the first build painted nothing), and a 10 cm eef sphere -> the gripper column (the sphere removed the overlay under a descending gripper). f6o2_tasks.json checks.M / M_descent hold the sphere version; results/flawed/f6o2/mcheck.json holds the registered rule. The wrist sprite is the agentview patch upsampled (a blockier plate rim than the real one).
metrics.design: f6o's covers, conditions a/b/c/d, park and beside rules, frozen policies and servers, on 124 NEW displaced-layout states drawn by fx's F6 rule (fam np.random.seed = env.seed = 810000 + k, disp default_rng(811000 + k), k = 24..147; the rule reproduces fx's stored k = 0-23 exactly; none duplicates a stored F6 state; 0 of 124 rejected by f6o's render check). Rows 24-27 = smoke, rows 28-147 = main (120 states). Branch seed_base 14000000 + 1000 k. Arm M = condition b + a memory overlay: at the first query the learned segmenter's plate mask (agentview) and its depth back-projected 3D centre (fx_r.centre) are stored with the RGB sprite; from the cover's move on, both cameras get the remembered plate painted at its remembered position (the wrist view by reprojecting the agentview sprite through the plate plane with the camera model), except where the visible surface is > 12 cm above the plane, in the robot's own gripper column (within 10 cm in xy of its proprioceptive eef position and higher than 3 cm below it), or segmented as bowl. Overlay check (f6o2_mcheck.py, DUMMY rollouts, painted vs a's true plate pixels at queries after the move, 124 states): agentview IoU median .987 (min .86); wrist at the home pose median .47 (.56 where the plate has >= 200 wrist px; the plate is a sliver at the wrist image edge there); scripted descent over the plate, wrist IoU .88-.90 at 25/15/10/6 cm above the cover. Segmenter plate IoU at the first query median .987, centre xy error 1.7 mm. Reference = fx_ref (servo seeds 10-12, P_min s10-s12) on the new states, better system.
metrics.mapping: experiments/f6o2_read.py as hashed, on the NEW main states alone (120). Per model, first matching row: NO POWER iff s(a) < .50 or reference < .60; MEMORY ABSENT iff s(d) - s(b) > .10 with CI lower bound > 0 and s(b) - s(c) CI upper bound < .10; MEMORY USED iff s(b) - s(c) > .10 with lower bound > 0; else PARTIAL (f6o_read.verdict). Fix: NO POWER if F6 row is NO POWER; MEMORY RESTORED iff s(M) - s(b) > .10 with lower bound > 0 and s(M)'s CI lower bound >= s(b)'s CI upper bound; else NO VERDICT (M - b reported). Also reported: M - d, M - c, a - d, the F6 rows pooled with f6o's states 4-23 (descriptive). Paired over states, bootstrap B = 2,000, seed 0. F6 HOLDS iff MEMORY ABSENT for both pi0.5 and GR00T; F6 FIX iff MEMORY RESTORED for both.
metrics.power_note: At n = 120 the b - c CI half-width is about +-.11 for pi0.5 (b, c near .5) and +-.07 for GR00T (b, c near .1), so MEMORY ABSENT on pi0.5 needs a b - c point estimate at or below about -.01.
metrics.prediction: F6 does not HOLD: GR00T MEMORY ABSENT, pi0.5 PARTIAL (its b - c upper bound stays above .10). F6 FIX: MEMORY RESTORED on both models (pi0.5 M near d, about .9; GR00T M about .5 against b about .1).
metrics.seen: Smoke, pi0.5 only, new smoke rows 24-27 (job 4701598; read job 4701837, .claude_tmp/pp/f6o2_read_smoke.json), read after the prediction was written; nothing in the mapping changed after it: a 1.00, b .50, c .75, d 1.00, M .75; reference 1.00 (P_min 1.00, servo .00 on these 4 states). Failed b / c / M bowls end near the plate. Plate visible at later queries: b .64, c .38, M .42 (true plate pixels, the occluder leak). Smoke reference also run (jobs 4701599, 4701600). GR00T not smoked. Also seen: f6o's n = 20 result (SR 45.5).
